narrative: Today's brief highlights significant developments in AI policy and infrastructure, with Anthropic facing government directives and NVIDIA leading in AI benchmarks. The tech world also saw SpaceX's impactful IPO, new cybercrime challenges using AI, and ongoing space exploration efforts by NASA.

highlights.title: Google sues Chinese cybercrime network that used Gemini to automate scams
